catalog.title: Seiko V2
catalog.note: JDM annual, volume 2 (Seiko Quartz lines, Chariot, divers, bracelet and ladies' lines, pendant/ring/kimono/pocket watches, watches for the blind, digital, railway watch, stopwatches, pair watches, Nina Ricci and Playboy). Each caption prints the ref in blue (●QGA010) and the list price (円), then the movement — a four-character calibre (9983, 7830, A229, F033 …) or a family code (99GQW, 58KQW, 71LQW, 75TPW, 71TPW, 26JQW, 79JQW, 11S, 88ST …) — with jewels (石) on mechanical pieces, the case material (SS, HSS, SGP, HGP, GC, ASGP/APDP/AWGP/ACRP A-grade plating, PDP, TPDP, TSGP, GPDP two-colour plating, SILV·ASGP, 14KYS, ALM light alloy, TI-N NSB), a crystal/feature line, the case code printed as CCCC<case-dial> (the bracketed part is kept as caseDialCode, the full line in `code`) and a box with either the bracelet/strap code (X…) or the strap width in mm. `caliber` is the printed movement number, or the four-character prefix of the case code where the movement is printed as a family code; family codes with a two-digit prefix (16<…>, 11<…>, 88<…>) leave it blank. No CCCC-NNNN case–movement ref is printed. Water resistance printed once in the page header (日常生活用防水 etc.) is applied to every watch on that page. The pair-watch pages (printed 136–139) print only ref and price; those watches also appear with full captions earlier. The scan skips printed pages 12, 52, 70, 86 and 110–118, 121–122, 125–126 and 128.
catalog.method: Vision transcription in-harness of 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026), every field verified against full-resolution caption crops of the PDF.
